admitted_blockers.summary: Baseline scores, ablation scores, contrast results, candidate score, and clean leakage status are source-generated constants or self-consistent artifact values rather than measured executions.

Replay verifies hash and field consistency but cannot recompute behavior from serialized_state plus observation because observations are not stored as replayable objects and the replay code does not execute the candidate causal path.
Train contexts, seed families, and frozen counterfactual pairs exist in the manifest but are not meaningfully consumed by the run; counterfactual behavior is selected by rejection search.
Provenance source_trace_ids are generated identifiers and are not resolvable to trace objects in trace.jsonl.

claim_ceiling: bounded external red-team failure admission evidence only
